newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African June government financing 8.04 bln rand.
newsitem.headline: S.African June government financing 8.04 bln rand.

text.p: South African government financing totalled 8.04 billion rand in June, bringing total financing to 18.4 billion rand so far this year -- half of government's budgeted financing plans for the whole fiscal year.
The Finance Department said in a statement that financing of 2.59 billion rand was obtained through the issue of government bonds, while short-term loans increased by 1.28 billion rand.
An amount of 3.82 billion rand was received as foreign loans, while 345.3 million rand was transferred from the IMF Account at the Reserve Bank to the Exchequer account.

* The discount on zero coupon bonds is treated on an accrual basis. The discount is written off over the life of the loan and provided for annually as interest expenditure. At the same time a corresponding amount is added to new loans received by the Exchequer.
Government bonds to the amount of 783.4 million rand were redeemed from April to June 1997, the statement said.
